info.title: Datalake
info.description: What one dataset holds for a month: how its records are distributed, and how many partitions they occupy. Read by the /data page.

get.summary: One dataset's distribution and partition count for a month
get.description: Data names a dataset, not a stream: the stream id 'us-national-weather' is answered with a 400, where the dataset is 'us-weather-alert'. The sec stream has two datasets: 'sec', its filings, and 'sec-companyfacts', the XBRL numbers the S&P 500 companies filed.

parameters.name: Scale
parameters.description: The period, as JSON. The year defaults to the current one. The month is two digits, as a string; without it the year is described whole.

200.description: Two CSV strings. data-distribution has a total_records column (total_events for us-weather-alert) beside the columns that dataset is grouped by; partition has a single count row.

data-distribution.description: CSV with a header row. The grouping columns differ by dataset: bls has category and series; sec, category and form; sec-companyfacts, category and form as well, its category each fact's status, new, repeated or changed; stock-market, sector, industry and total_tickers; us-weather-alert, severity and event; stock-split, split_date, sector, industry, total_tickers and tickers.

partition.description: CSV with a single count column: the partitions the period occupies. For sec-companyfacts, the days with facts filed.

sec-companyfacts.summary: sec-companyfacts, August 2026: 97,343 facts filed on 21 days

400.description: Data is not one of the datasets, or Scale names a period the datalake does not hold.

500.description: The distribution could not be computed. The report carries a message.

RateLimited.description: Too many requests from this address in a few minutes: today 100 in 5 minutes, and an answer from the cache counts too. Wait for `Retry-After` seconds, then ask again. The report says the limit and the window in force, which can change: read them rather than assume today's.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before asking again: the window the limit is counted over.

limit.description: How many requests one address may make in the window.

window_seconds.description: The window the requests are counted over, in seconds.

report.error: Too many requests from this address. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
